name: lexcerta
description: LexCerta gives legal professionals access to official French and European legal sources in ChatGPT: legislation, case law, collective agreements, tax guidance, company registers and public procurement. Search a collection, then retrieve the source document to check its text and date before drawing a conclusion. LexCerta provides documentary research, not legal advice, and does not store search content.

interface.longDescription: LexCerta gives legal professionals access to official French and European legal sources in ChatGPT: legislation, case law, collective agreements, tax guidance, company registers and public procurement. Search a collection, then retrieve the source document to check its text and date before drawing a conclusion. LexCerta provides documentary research, not legal advice, and does not store search content.
defaultPrompt: Que dit le code civil sur la résolution d’un contrat pour inexécution ?
Trouve des arrêts récents de la Cour de cassation sur la rupture brutale des relations commerciales établies.
Ouvre le texte complet de l’article 1224 du code civil.

positive.description: Search consolidated French code articles on a specific point of law.
positive.prompt: Que dit le code civil sur la résolution d’un contrat pour inexécution ?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching code articles with their identifiers and the date of the consolidated version, so the user can open the exact text.

positive.description: Search French judicial case law on a specific question.
positive.prompt: Trouve des arrêts récents de la Cour de cassation sur la rupture brutale des relations commerciales établies.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching decisions with court, date and identifier, which the user can then open in full.

positive.description: Open one specific article in full from its identifier, the verification step that follows a search.
positive.prompt: Ouvre le texte complet de l’article 1224 du code civil.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the full wording of the article together with the version date, so the user can read the source rather than a summary.

positive.description: Search French collective bargaining agreements, a distinct corpus from codes and case law.
positive.prompt: Quelle convention collective s’applique aux bureaux d’études techniques ?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching agreements with their identifiers, without asserting that any one of them applies to the user’s situation.

positive.description: Retrieve the official metadata and source link for a European Union directive.
positive.prompt: Retrouve la référence officielle et le lien EUR-Lex de la directive 2014/55/UE (CELEX 32014L0055).
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the directive’s official identification — title, adopting bodies, date and place of publication — with its EUR-Lex address.

negative.description: Do not trigger for requests unrelated to legal research.
negative.prompt: Quel temps fera-t-il à Paris demain ?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; the request has nothing to do with legal sources.

negative.description: Do not trigger for foreign law, which is adjacent to the app’s purpose but outside the corpora it can reach.
negative.prompt: Que prévoit le droit fédéral américain en matière de non-concurrence ?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; it only covers French and European Union official sources and cannot answer on United States law.

negative.description: Do not trigger for actions the app cannot perform, since every tool is read-only.
negative.prompt: Envoie un e-mail à mon client pour lui résumer ce dossier.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; it only reads official sources and cannot send messages or change anything.

publication.release_notes: SedLex is now LexCerta. Updated branding, listing URLs and MCP endpoint to https://app.lexcerta.fr/mcp/.

fr-FR.subtitle: Sources officielles du droit
fr-FR.description: LexCerta donne aux professionnels du droit un accès direct aux sources juridiques officielles françaises et européennes depuis ChatGPT : codes et textes consolidés, jurisprudence judiciaire, administrative et constitutionnelle, conventions collectives, doctrine fiscale, droit de l’Union européenne, registres d’entreprises et marchés publics. Deux gestes structurent le travail : rechercher dans un fonds, puis consulter le document complet par son identifiant pour vérifier le texte et sa date avant d’en tirer une conclusion. LexCerta ne rend aucune consultation juridique et ne conserve pas le contenu des recherches.
